Instrument.name: Apollo 16 Lunar Surface Experiments Package Lunar Surface Magnetometer Experiment
Instrument.description: The Apollo 16 Lunar Surface Experiments Package (ALSEP) Lunar Surface Magnetometer (LSM) Experiment consisted of a triaxial fluxgate magnetometer and was part of a three-station network (Apollo 12,15,16) primarily designed to investigate the electromagnetic properties of the interior of the Moon. The three magnetometers could measure magnetic fields in different ranges (+/- 50, 100, or 200 gammas) that could be selected by ground command. The instrument was oriented on the lunar surface by the astronauts with a shadowgraph and bubble level.
